name: Drumpf: Presidential Dating Simulator
source:
Young Dreamer and White House intern, Larry Lopez, is in for the fight of his life after making a high stakes bet with the President: now he must either convince Drumpf to fall in love with him over the course of the next three days and consummate a green card wedding, or be shot into space.

Will Larry succeed in his quest for love, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness, or find himself deported to distant stars?  It’s up to YOU to decide!

拉里会成功地追求爱情、自由和幸福，还是会发现自己被驱逐到遥远的星球？由你决定！
